schools.name: Wood End Infant & Pre-School
schools.inspectionPrecis: Pupils are very proud to be part of this nurturing school. Relationships are at the heart of everything the school does. Pupils use the school's rules to help them make positive decisions and work together happily. Staff form trusting relationships with pupils that help them to feel safe. There is a calm and kind atmosphere. Staff know pupils well and foster a culture of mutual respect and care. Incidents of bullying or discrimination are very rare. Pupils know that staff will help them deal quickly with any concerns they may have. Pupils feel listened to and valued. They have a firm sense of belonging. Over time, pupils attend school more regularly than they did, although there are some pupils who still do not…
